CLAIRE COSTELLO stands before her mother's gravestone with a sorrowful expression, lost in memory.
CLAIRE’S MOTHER lies in bed, looking weak. Claire stands by the bedside with tears in her eyes, holding her mother's hand.

Claire, as the Costello family’s heir, you're gifted and have achieved remarkable success in the business world. But I don't want you to repeat the tragedies of your father and brother. Promise me you'll hide your identity and real name. Marry a good man, and live an ordinary life...
Claire places a bouquet of white roses on the gravestone and speaks softly.
Mom, I promise you, I'll hide who I am and live an ordinary life.
Claire stands. Behind her are luxury cars and uniformed bodyguards (two rows, six on each side). Butler GARY BECK stands at the front, respectfully awaiting her instructions.
From today on, none of you need to follow me anymore. Gary, you'll manage the Costello family estate.
As you wish, Miss.
Claire looks back at the gravestone one last time, then turns to leave.
INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRY OFFICE - DAY4 4
Claire wears a simple wedding dress, standing beside KYLE RAMON. He holds Claire's hand, his eyes full of love. CLOSE UP: Two marriage certificates in Claire's other hand.
I, Kyle Ramon, swear to love only
Claire Garcia for the rest of my life this life. I promise you, once my work in Europe is finished, I'll return to your side and we’ll have a grand wedding ceremony.

Don't worry, I'll take good care of your mother and our home. I’ll wait for you. TRANSITIONAL SHOT: Camera pans to roses on the registry desk, then back. INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRY OFFICE - DAY - ONE YEAR LATER5 5*
We’re still in the marriage registry office, but now the two are separated by a desk. Claire stands while Kyle, dressed in a suit, sits across from her. He looks arrogant and cold.

Claire. I've fallen in love with my business partner, Sarah White, and we're getting married soon. Let's get divorced. This is the divorce agreement. Kyle slides a document across the desk to Claire. CLOSE UP:
The word "Divorce" is printed on the paper. Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Remember when you promised to love me and only me for the rest of your life?

Forget that. I didn't know what I wanted back then. Then I met Sarah —she’s talented and has achieved remarkable success in the business world. Only then did I realize how attractive an independent woman could be!
Sarah White? I want to meet her.
INT. KYLE'S VILLA - LIVING ROOM - DAY6 6

At the villa entrance, a pair of high heels steps gracefully out of a luxury car, exuding elegance. The high heels walk directly into the villa. CLOSE UP, FOLLOWING SHOT: As we hear the elegant sound of heels on the floor, SARAH WHITE (sunglasses and perfectly styled curls) makes a striking entrance. Claire, Kyle, and PETUNIA RAMON (50’s, Kyle’s mother) are sitting in the living room. They look up as Sarah approaches. EMILY LEE, the maid currently cleaning the counter in the open kitchen, also sneaks a glance. Petunia rushes forward with an ingratiating smile, beaming.
Sarah! Kyle's been telling me all about how wonderful you are. You're even more beautiful than you are in the photos!
Oh, Kyle. That sounds just like him. He’s always praising me to everyone. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
(slightly shocked, to Petunia) You knew about this already?

Of course! Sarah's from a prestigious family, and she’s also an internationally renowned expert on AI and cybersecurity. No wonder Kyle is so smitten with you. You must be tired after all that travel. Sarah stands next to Kyle, exuding pride. *

Kyle and I have been flying around the world for various projects in the past few years, so I’m used to it. Unlike some people who rarely leave the house. Claire, I heard you wanted to see me—do you have something to say? Claire's expression returns to calm.

I hear you're a pioneer for women's rights at the American Professional Women's Association. It seems like you’re considered to be a role model for independent women. Does it set a good example for other women to interfere in someone else’s marriage and trample on another women?

Your jealousy is showing! I hate women like you: you don’t have a career and your life revolves around keeping house! Kyle and I * are in love. You’re the one who couldn't keep your husband, and you're attacking me? Sarah sits on the sofa and pushes the document on the table toward Claire again. Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Just sign already. Trying to hold on only makes you more pathetic.
You've always been sensible, Claire. Just sign the divorce papers and let’s part ways cleanly. Don't stand in the way of Kyle's happiness.
Claire picks up the divorce agreement and flips through it. CLOSE UP: one page clearly states "Wife voluntarily relinquishes all marital property.”
You’re so eager to leave me with nothing.
For all these years, I was the one supporting Kyle's career. Every * penny that you spent was earned by the two of us. How dare you try to take our property? Claire's gaze pierces Kyle like a sword.

Never mind that I never spent any of your money—I subsidized your whole family's daily expenses. Kyle, have you forgotten where your startup capital came from? And now you have an affair and want to leave me with nothing? I've never seen anything so shameless! Kyle's expression instantly darkens, and Sarah's smile disappears.
You ignorant woman! The little money you could chip in meant nothing to me. A genius like me could have easily found other investors without your help.
Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
All you care about is the money, right? If you sign, I'll be merciful and give you a million. Sarah grabs Kyle's hand. *

Don’t give her anything! Let’s see what she can do about it. Hmph. If you wants to sue, I have the best legal team in California. So go ahead—try to bargain with us, make a scene. Let's see if you have what it takes.
And what do you think about this,
Mrs. Ramon?
Seeing as you took care of me, Claire, I’ll go easy on you andlet you stay as a maid. After all, what other job could a worthless housewife like you find?
Claire looks at Sarah.
What do you think of that, Ms. Pioneer-for-Women’s-Rights?
Sure. We’ll keep you on...as a maid. But you'd better know your place. Don't try to seduce the man of the house.
Well, when it comes to seduction, who could compete with certain women who speak of womens’ rights then chase after married men?
Don’t push your luck, you bitch! Actually, I don't need a maid like you! You should fall from grace and end up on the streets!
Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Claire laughs, with a cold edge to it.

Life is already hard enough for women. We have to deal with the pain of menstruation and childbirth, the toil of housework, the burden of misogyny—none of these are easy. And you two are women yourselves—why would you bully another woman like this?
Bully? We’re going easy on you! All you did was do some housework. What do you have to be proud of?
Exactly, you ungrateful little thing! A woman like you with no career and no background—without my son, you're nothing!
You really think my worth needs to be defined by a worthless husband? Without me, Kyle wouldn't have succeeded at all. I should ask you: what right do you have to enjoy the fruits of that success?
Ridiculous! You're just a housewife who does the chores. You really think you were behind to Kyle's success?
The onlooking maid, Emily, throws down the cloth she’s holding and runs over.

You're bullying her too much! Do you even know how dedicated and hardworking Miss Garcia was? She took care of the old mistress when she was sick and kept this household together! Sarah raises her hand and slaps Emily. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Shut up! What right do you have to interfere in your employers' business!?
Claire immediately slaps Sarah back.
How dare you hit my employee!

Face the facts, Claire. You don't deserve to stand next to us. Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
You're the ones who don't deserve it. Fine, I agree to the divorce.

From this day forward, we have nothing to do with each other.

Claire takes out her phone and calls her butler, Gary.
Gary, immediately cancel the multi- billion dollar contract that's about to be signed with Ramon Tech.
Yes, I'll take care of it right away. But you specifically instructed that contract be given to your husband's company...
He's not my husband anymore. Flames of revenge flicker in Claire's eyes.
From this moment on, I will take back everything that I gave you.

Claire stands by the window holding a glass of red wine, gazing into the night. Gary stands respectfully nearby.
How are things?
As you instructed, I've arranged for Emily, the dismissed maid, to receive a new position: logistics manager at the Costello five-star hotel.
Emily helped me a lot when she was working at Kyle's. She stood up for me and lost her job. She deserves a good position. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)

Don't tell Curtis about my divorce yet. Just say that everything's fine. As for a meeting, there’ll be more opportunities later. Gary, I've decided to return to the Costello family and manage the business again.

What's so urgent?
The latest news, sir. It’s about Claire Costello. Daniel freezes at this name.

In a luxury car, Jack sits in the driver's seat. Daniel is in the back wearing an expensive suit, with a large beautiful bouquet beside him.
Boss, is this the Miss Costello you've been thinking about for ten years?

Claire walks out. Daniel watches her silently, his eyes full of love. As Daniel reaches to open the car door, through the window he sees Kyle, wearing a simple plaid shirt, running up to Claire with a single flower.
Claire, will you be my girlfriend?
Claire smiles and nods, Kyle hugs her happily. Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Daniel witnesses all this through the car window. Fighting heartbreak, he puts away the bouquet and closes the window.

Daniel and his assistant have reached the elevator.
Kyle brought another woman home and forced Miss Claire to agree to a divorce. She’s now looking for a contract marriage partner...
Get the car ready. I want to see her in ten minutes.
The elevator opens and Daniel strides in.

Hello, Miss Costello. I'm your contract marriage partner.
Claire glances at Mr. Smith's photo on her phone screen, and responds coldly.
You're not Mr. Smith.
But I'm more suitable. Daniel slides a pad in front of Claire, showing data for tampered logs.

Though the backend commands were erased, the vehicle system shows that someone tampered with the instructions, causing a brake failure.
How do you know this?
You don't need to understand it all right now. If you want the truth, let's make a deal: marry me, and I'll help you find the truth.
Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Seems you understand this marriage is just a business deal. Everyone is here is chasing after the reward—what about you?
You don't need to worry about what I want.
Claire moves closer to Daniel, speaking deliberately and with intimidation.
I'm not an easy person to deal with, you know. If you're planning anything sneaky, you're dead.
Of course I know. You are Claire Costello, after all.
CUT TO

I'll divorce you in one year. Then I'll give you a villa downtown and fifty million dollars as compensation.

Claire puts the marriage certificate in her bag and calmly shakes Daniel's hand. Gary approaches, holding a gold-embossed invitation. Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Miss, Kyle and Sarah have sent wedding banquet invitations to all four major families in California.

I wonder how Kyle would react if he knew his ex-wife is actually the same Costello family leader that he's so desperate to impress.
Claire takes the invitation, giving a cold laugh.
Tell him I'll attend. But first, I need to put on my "battle armor."

Miss, the dresses here are quite expensive. I'm afraid they're not suitable for someone like you.
Excuse me, were you speaking to me?
Who else? Is there another poor person in here?
Judging people by appearances is very dangerous, Miss. I'm shocked that someone like you works here.
Rude little tramp... Sarah's shrill voice cuts in.
Well, well, well! Look who it is. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Claire and the saleswoman turn. Sarah walks over exuding confidence, holding Kyle's arm. Saleswoman A immediately rushes over warmly.
Miss White, you're finally here! We just got a new batch of dresses, and we wanted you to be the first to see them!
Claire? Huh, since when can the poor just waltz into luxury stores?
Hmph. She's just a housewife who got dumped. How could she possibly buy anything here? She's probably here to steal something. You better watch her carefully.
How ironic - the pot calls the kettle black. You're a serial man- stealer, and you still have the nerve to accuse others of stealing?

Enough, you jealous woman!, I know you're trying to get my attention and win me back, Claire. But listen carefully: I only have eyes for Sarah. If you keep pestering me, don't blame me if I get upset!

You think too highly of yourself, Kyle. Between you and Sarah, one is an ungrateful cheater and the other is a shameless homewrecker. Every extra second I spend talking to you feels like a waste of my life.
Claire, this act is so pathetic.
Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Let me give you some advice: get out of here, before you make a bigger fool of yourself.
You're not in a position to tell me that.

They're all here, Ms. White. You're so beautiful, you'll look stunning in any one of them!
These dresses aren't even the top- tier dresses for this brand.

Claire points to an ornate, elegant gown.
This dress is the most expensive one in this store. It was custom- made for me by Miss Harper. CLOSE-UP: The price tag clearly reads: $100,000.
Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)

You must be crazy. How dare you pretend to know our head designer? Miss Harper, is the chief haute couture designer certified by the French Federation of Couture. She never accepts commissions and hasn't done any private work in a long time.
Exactly! Even I haven't met Miss Harper yet. How can you, an impoverished former housewife, dare pretend to know her!
Looks like your lies have been exposed. Aren't you embarrassed, Claire? Just get out of here, and spare yourself the further humiliation
I have an appointment with Miss Harper to try on dresses here today. When she arrives, everything will be cleared up.
Ha! What a convincing performance. You're just making this up to one- up me, aren't you? But this dress really is high-end. Wrap it up for me.
You can't take this dress.

Ridiculous! I'm one of the top five VIPs here in terms of annual spending. You—you low-life whose husband abandoned her, you pathetic housewife, how dare you try and compete with me? Pink Rev. (mm/dd/yy)

I told you, you can't take this dress.

I'll give you this dress.

I think they're a perfect match. They’ve both got the stench of poverty. I feel like I'm lowering myself just by talking to them.
Hey, poor boy, do you recognize this brand? Do you know how much this dress costs? And you still dare to set foot into this shop?
I don't need to look at the price tag to buy something. I could buy the whole store if I wanted to, let alone one dress.

Hmph, you have the delusions of a rich man and none of the wealth. I don't think this boytoy has any other skills besides bragging. He's just as fake as that bitch Claire.
I can't wait to see these poor fools admit defeat and get kicked out of here.

This is... a Centurion black card?!

MISS HARPER walks in: she’s a middle-aged woman dressed in a vintage and elegant style, with a lot of personality.
Miss Harper?

Your VIP card is canceled, starting today.

Power outage?
